finding.summary: The send() function passes user-controlled text (Jira ticket keys and comment IDs) directly to tmux send-keys with -l flag. While -l prevents special key interpretation, literal newline characters in the text will be sent as Ctrl+J, potentially causing premature command execution before the explicit Enter is sent. Jira comment IDs could theoretically contain newlines.
finding.fix: Sanitize the text parameter by replacing newlines with spaces or escaping them, or split multi-line text into multiple send-keys calls with explicit Enter between lines.

label: false_positive
label_reason: Raised in review and merged with the file unchanged.
